title: Mini Math Quiz
body:
Goal: finish a 2-question quiz that keeps score. (No turtle this time - everything happens in the Shell.)

  1. Open starter.py and press Run (F5). Answer question 1 in the Shell.
  2. Read how question 1 works: input, then int, then if ... else, and score = score + 1 when the answer is right.
  3. Follow the # TODOs: add question 2 (What is 9 + 15?, the answer is 24) the same way.
  4. At the very end, print the score, like: You scored 2 out of 2.
  5. Test it twice: once with right answers, once with wrong answers.

Done looks like: right answers say Correct!, wrong answers say the right answer kindly, and the last line shows the score.

Challenge: add a third question. Remember to change "out of 2" to "out of 3".

hints.label: Hint 1
hints.title: Where to look
hints.html: Read Question 1 in starter.py slowly. It has four parts: ask, check, add to the score if right, and show a kind message if wrong. Question 2 will use the same four parts.

hints.label: Hint 2
hints.title: Try this
hints.html: Copy the pattern of Question 1, but change the question text and the right answer. Remember input() gives text, so wrap it so it becomes a number. At the very end, use print to show the score variable along with some words.

hints.label: Hint 3
hints.title: Almost there
hints.html: Question 2 starts with answer = ____(input("____ ")), then if answer == ____:. In the if part, print "Correct!" and add 1 to score. In the else: part, print the right answer kindly. Last, print the score with some words around it, like the example in the README.

starter.name: starter.py
starter.raw:
# Mini Math Quiz
# A variable called score remembers how many answers were right.

print("Welcome to the Mini Math Quiz!")
score = 0

# Question 1
answer = int(input("What is 7 x 8? "))
if answer == 56:
    print("Correct!")
    score = score + 1
else:
    print("Good try! 7 x 8 = 56")

# Question 2
# TODO: ask "What is 9 + 15? " - the right answer is 24
# TODO: if it is right, print "Correct!" and add 1 to score
# TODO: else, print the right answer kindly

# TODO: print the score, like: You scored 2 out of 2
